about: Explicit duplicate pairs the grouping rules in scripts/lib/dedupe-rules.ts cannot see. Read by scripts/dedupe-colors.ts. The declared canonical is kept; a pair is refused when the loser no longer holds loserCode, when either row is missing, or when the canonical is not in the live feed while the loser is. Source: docs/data-audit-2026-11.md.
